na838a26b11.headline: Worrying indicators for the Algerian economy due to Corona
na838a26b11.summary: Algeria's economy is impacted by the coronavirus spread, dinar depreciation, rising inflation, halted company operations, and decreased oil revenues.
na838a26b11.why: Algeria's economy is heavily dependent on oil; disruptions and inflation pose risks to growth and fiscal stability.
